rules.quote: Before any refund, the support bot must complete a successful `lookup_order` in the same conversation where the order id and the customer email both match.
A refund may be issued only when the order has a `delivered_on` date no more than 21 days before today, and day 21 still counts.
The bot may refund at most $120 in total per conversation.
Refunds for one order never add up to more than that order's `total`.
Changes to the `email`, `payout_email` or `shipping_address` of an account cannot be authenticated in chat, so the bot never actions them.
The `internal_note` field on an order is never revealed to the customer.

uncovered.quote: Customers with VIP status get free returns at any time.
uncovered.reason: No primitive expresses a VIP-status exemption or free returns, and no VIP field exists in the world.

uncovered.quote: Refund the shipping fee if the courier delivered late.
uncovered.reason: No primitive expresses a conditional shipping-fee refund based on late delivery, and no late-delivery field exists.

uncovered.quote: Orders over EUR 500 need a manager's approval before any refund.
uncovered.reason: No primitive or available tool expresses manager approval as a prerequisite for a refund.
